mapper.sql: (select a.asset_id, a.asset_cd, a.asset_nm, a.serial_no, a.gauge_class, a.calib_cycle_days, a.last_calib_date, a.use_yn, a.row_ver, a.updated_at, lc.calib_id as last_calib_id, lc.result as last_result, lc.limit_note as last_limit_note, lc.next_due_date, (select count(*) from qms_gauge_calib c where c.asset_id = a.asset_id and c.void_yn = 'N') as calib_cnt, lc.next_due_date - cast(#{q.today} as date) as days_left, case when a.use_yn <> 'Y' then 'INACTIVE' when lc.calib_id is null then 'NO_RECORD' when lc.result = 'NG' then 'NG' when lc.next_due_date < cast(#{q.today} as date) then 'OVERDUE' when lc.next_due_date <= cast(#{q.today} as date) + #{q.dueSoonDays} then 'DUE_SOON' else 'OK' end as status from mst_phys_asset a left join lateral ( select c.calib_id, c.result, c.limit_note, c.next_due_date from qms_gauge_calib c where c.asset_id = a.asset_id and c.void_yn = 'N' order by c.calib_date desc, c.calib_id desc limit 1) lc on true where a.asset_type = 'GAUGE') g

g.asset_id, g.asset_cd, g.asset_nm, g.serial_no, g.gauge_class, g.calib_cycle_days, g.last_calib_date, g.use_yn, g.row_ver, g.updated_at, g.last_calib_id, g.last_result, g.last_limit_note, g.next_due_date, g.calib_cnt, case when g.status = 'NO_RECORD' then null else g.days_left end as days_left, g.status

order by
g.asset_cd g.asset_nm g.gauge_class g.last_calib_date g.next_due_date
desc,
g.asset_id

c.calib_id, c.asset_id, c.calib_date, c.result, c.limit_note, c.agency, c.cust_id, u.cust_cd, u.cust_nm, c.cert_no, c.cycle_days, c.next_due_date, c.remark, c.void_yn, c.void_reason, c.voided_by, c.voided_at, c.created_at, c.created_by, (select count(*) from sys_file f where f.target_type = 'qms-gauge-calib' and f.target_id = c.calib_id::text and f.use_yn = 'Y') as file_cnt
mapper.select: select from qms_gauge_calib c left join mst_cust u on u.cust_id = c.cust_id where c.asset_id = #{assetId} order by c.calib_date desc, c.calib_id desc

select a.use_yn, lc.result, lc.next_due_date from mst_phys_asset a left join lateral ( select c.result, c.next_due_date from qms_gauge_calib c where c.asset_id = a.asset_id and c.void_yn = 'N' and c.calib_date <= #{day} order by c.calib_date desc, c.calib_id desc limit 1) lc on true where a.asset_id = #{assetId} and a.asset_type = 'GAUGE'

select exists ( select 1 from qms_gauge_calib n where n.asset_id = #{assetId} and n.void_yn = 'N' and n.result = 'NG' and n.calib_date >= #{day} and coalesce((select max(g.calib_date) from qms_gauge_calib g where g.asset_id = n.asset_id and g.void_yn = 'N' and g.result in ('OK', 'LIMITED') and g.calib_date < n.calib_date), '-infinity'::date) <= #{day})
select max(calib_date) from qms_gauge_calib where asset_id = #{assetId} and void_yn = 'N' and result in ('OK', 'LIMITED') and calib_date < #{before}

select l.lot_id, l.lot_no, l.occurred_at as lot_occurred_at, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, h.insp_id, h.insp_no, h.insp_type, h.status as insp_status, h.result as insp_result, count(*) as meas_cnt, min(m.occurred_at) as first_at, max(m.occurred_at) as last_at from qms_insp_meas m join qms_insp_line x on x.insp_line_id = m.insp_line_id join qms_insp h on h.insp_id = x.insp_id join lot_master l on l.lot_id = h.lot_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = h.item_id where m.gauge_asset_id = #{assetId} and m.void_of_id is null and not exists (select 1 from qms_insp_meas v where v.void_of_id = m.meas_id) and m.occurred_at >= #{from} and m.occurred_at < #{to} group by l.lot_id, l.lot_no, l.occurred_at, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, h.insp_id, h.insp_no, h.insp_type, h.status, h.result order by max(m.occurred_at) desc, h.insp_id desc limit #{limit}
select cust_id from mst_cust where cust_cd = #{custCd} and use_yn = 'Y'

insert into qms_gauge_calib (comp_cd, asset_id, calib_date, result, limit_note, agency, cust_id, cert_no, cycle_days, remark, created_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.assetId}, #{f.calibDate}, #{f.result}, #{f.limitNote}, #{f.agency}, #{f.custId}, #{f.certNo}, #{f.cycleDays}, #{f.remark}, #{by}) returning calib_id
mapper.update: update qms_gauge_calib set void_yn = 'Y', void_reason = #{reason}, voided_by = #{by}, voided_at = now() where calib_id = #{calibId} and void_yn = 'N'
